def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import defaultdict as dd2
    cnt=dd2(int)
    for row in I:
        for x in row: cnt[x]+=1
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    orig=defaultdict(set)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: orig[I[r][c]].add((r,c))
    res=[row[:] for row in I]
    def occupied(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and res[r][c]==bg
    for col,v in sorted(orig.items()):
        lo=min(v); hi=max(v)
        s=(1 if hi[0]>lo[0] else -1, 1 if hi[1]>lo[1] else -1)
        rr,cc=lo[0]-s[0], lo[1]-s[1]
        while occupied(rr,cc): res[rr][cc]=col; rr-=s[0]; cc-=s[1]
        rr,cc=hi[0]+s[0], hi[1]+s[1]
        while occupied(rr,cc): res[rr][cc]=col; rr+=s[0]; cc+=s[1]

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import defaultdict as dd2
    cnt=dd2(int)
    for row in I:
        for x in row: cnt[x]+=1
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    orig=defaultdict(set)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: orig[I[r][c]].add((r,c))
    res=[row[:] for row in I]
    def occupied(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and res[r][c]==bg
    for col,v in sorted(orig.items()):
        lo=min(v); hi=max(v)
        s=(1 if hi[0]>lo[0] else -1, 1 if hi[1]>lo[1] else -1)
        rr,cc=lo[0]-s[0], lo[1]-s[1]
        while occupied(rr,cc): res[rr][cc]=col; rr-=s[0]; cc-=s[1]
        rr,cc=hi[0]+s[0], hi[1]+s[1]
        while occupied(rr,cc): res[rr][cc]=col; rr+=s[0]; cc+=s[1]
    return res

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=defaultdict(int)
    for row in I:
        for x in row: cnt[x]+=1
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    res=[row[:] for row in I]
    def isbg(r,c): return 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and res[r][c]==bg
    # maximal diagonal segments (same-color cells diag-connected)
    used=set()
    segs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            col=res[r][c]
            if col==bg or (r,c) in used: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; used.add((r,c)); seg=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); seg.append((a,b))
                for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]:
                    aa,bb=a+dr,b+dc
                    if (aa,bb) not in used and res[aa][bb]==col:
                        used.add((aa,bb)); stack.append((aa,bb))
            d=(max(p[0] for p in seg)-min(p[0] for p in seg), max(p[1] for p in seg)-min(p[1] for p in seg))
            u=(d[0]>0,d[1]>0)
            top=min(seg); bot=max(seg)
            for p in seg:
                nr,nc=p[0]+u[0],p[1]+u[1]
                while isbg(nr,nc):
                    res[nr][nc]=col; nr+=u[0]; nc+=u[1]
    return res

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    comps=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=I[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while st:
                rr,cc=st.pop()
                for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]:
                    nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and (nr,nc) not in seen and I[nr][nc]==col:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); st.append((nr,nc)); comp.append((nr,nc))
            comps.append(comp)
    # overall centroid of fragment midpoints
    Ms=[sum(c)/2 for c in map(sum,comps)]  # (r+c)/2
    cr=sum(m[0] for m in Ms)/len(Ms); cc_=(sum(m[1] for m in Ms)/len(Ms)-cr)/W * 0  # dummy
    cr_sum=sum(m[0] for m in Ms); cc_sum=sum(m[1]-m[0]/1 for m in Ms)
    Cr,Cc=cr_sum/len(Ms), cc_sum/len(Ms)
    res=[]
    for comp in comps:
        p=min(comp); q=max(comp); d=(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1])
        md=((p[0]+q[0])/2,(p[1]+q[1])/2)
        rd,cd=md[0]-Cr, md[1]-Cc
        def norm(v): return (v[0]>0)-(v[0]<0)
        sgn_r=norm(rd); sgn_c=norm(cd)
        # candidate directions along the line: s*d and -s*d where s = sign aligned with projection
        proj=lambda sd:(rd*sd[0]+cd*sd[1])
        best=max(((abs(proj(sd)),sd) for sd in [(d[0]*sgn_r, d[1]*sgn_c)]) , key=lambda x:x[0])
        d2=best[1]
        for rr,cc in comp:
            nr,nc=rr+d2[0], cc+d2[1]
            while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and O[nr][nc]==bg:
                O[nr][nc]=col; nr+=d2[0]; nc+=d2[1]
    return O

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    O=[r[:] for r in I]; seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=I[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; comp=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while st:
                rr,cc=st.pop()
                for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]:
                    nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and (nr,nc) not in seen and I[nr][nc]==col:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); st.append((nr,nc)); comp.append((nr,nc))
            if len(comp)!=2: continue
            p=min(comp); q=max(comp); d=(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1])
            step=max(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1]))
            # direction: away from grid center (projection onto midpoint offset relative to center)
            mr=((p[0]+q[0])/2)/H; mc=((p[1]+q[1])/2)/W
            sr=1 if mr<0.5 else -1
            scd=1 if mc<0.5 else -1
            sd=scd*(d[1]//step); si=sr*(d[0]//step)
            for a,b in [(si,sd)]:
                nr,nc=rr+a*step, cc+b*step
                while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and O[nr][nc]==bg:
                    O[nr][nc]=col; nr+=a*step; nc+=b*step
    return O
